jd:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Infotainment Software team plays a critical role in delivering the digital experiences that drivers and passengers interact with every day, from vehicle controls and connected services to media, navigation, and intelligent in-car applications. As an Infotainment Software Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers developing Android-based applications and features that power Lucid's next-generation in-vehicle experiences. Through hands-on development, testing, debugging, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help build reliable, high-quality software that enhances the customer experience while supporting Lucid's mission to inspire the adoption of sustainable energy through groundbreaking technology and exceptional user experiences.
 
Role and Responsibilities
  • Develop and enhance Android applications and features using Kotlin/Java and Android development frameworks. 
  • Support the implementation of new features, UI improvements, and application functionality. 
  • Investigate and fix software defects, including reproducing issues, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. 
  • Write and maintain unit tests and automated tests to improve code quality and regression coverage. 
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding, architecture, and development best practices. 
  • Work with Git-based development workflows, including creating branches, submitting merge/pull requests, and addressing review feedback. 
  • Use Android debugging and development tools such as Android Studio, ADB, and Logcat. 
  • Collaborate with software engineers, QA, UX, and other teams to develop and validate features. 
  • Assist with application performance, stability, and reliability improvements. 
  • Learn and contribute to Android Automotive / in-vehicle application development, including integration with vehicle and platform services where applicable. 
  • Explore and apply AI-assisted development tools to improve developer productivity, testing, debugging, and code quality. 
  • Document designs, implementation details, test results, and lessons learned. 
  • Complete a well-defined internship project or feature that can be demonstrated at the end of the internship. 
Must Have Skills
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Good understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming. 
  • Experience with Kotlin, Java, C++, or another object-oriented programming language. 
  • Familiarity with Android application development or strong interest in learning Android. 
  • Understanding of fundamental concepts such as data structures, algorithms, multithreading, and software design. 
  • Familiarity with Git or other source-control systems. 
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment 
Nice to Have Skills
  • Academic, personal, or internship experience developing an Android application. 
  • Experience with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Architecture Components, MVVM, or similar application architectures. 
  • Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, or other Android testing frameworks. 
  • Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, networking, or asynchronous programming. 
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line development tools. 
  • Exposure to Android Automotive OS (AAOS), Automotive APIs, embedded systems, or connected vehicles is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted software development tools is a plus 
Education
  • Field(s) of study: Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related fields
  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree program at an accredited university
  • Proof of enrollment in current or into next program (MS, PhD)

Program Information: 

  • Timing: May- August, or June-September pending class schedules. 
  • Duration of Internship: Our internship program is 12 weeks; the end date is flexible based on individual needs. 
  • Work Location & Environment: This position will be in Newark, CA, and is fully in-person. You must be prepared to start onsite for your first day of employment. The working environment will be a mix of lab & office work. 
  • Compensation: Student compensation is based on location and current degree level, non-negotiable ranging from $53 to $72 (subject to changes). 
  • Relocation: May be provided on a case-to-case basis. 
  • Housing/Transportation: You must provide your own living arrangements and transportation in the local area. 
  • Background Check: All offers of employment are contingent on clearing a background check. 
  • Drug Screening: All offers of employment are contingent on passing a drug screen. 
  • Medical benefits: Dental, vision, and medical on day 1 for all interns working full-time.

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. As an AI & Data intern, you will work alongside data scientists, data engineers, analysts and AI FDEs to build AI and analytics solutions on real data across Lucid. You must possess a strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals and data analysis. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and is curious about emerging AI technologies. 

Please note: this role sits within Lucid’s AI & Data team. Based on your skills and interests, you will be matched to projects in at least one of the following focus areas: 

  • Generative AI and LLM Applications (retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and assistants) 
  • Machine Learning and Data Science (predictive modeling, forecasting, and anomaly detection) 
  • AI Data Engineering and MLOps (data pipelines, model deployment, and monitoring)

  • Own one or more AI/ML projects from problem definition through a working prototype or production handoff 
  • Build and evaluate LLM-powered applications, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistants and AI agents, that help teams across Lucid find and use data and documents faster 
  • Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models on real-world vehicle, manufacturing, and business data 
  • Explore, clean, and transform large datasets using SQL and Python, and engineer features for modeling 
  • Analyze data and build dashboards and reports that turn model results and business data into actionable insights for stakeholders 
  • Help deploy models and AI services as APIs or internal tools, and monitor their performance over time 
  • Partner with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate their needs into AI solutions 
  • Document your work and present your results to the team and leadership at the end of the internship

  • Working knowledge of SQL and experience exploring and cleaning real-world, messy datasets  
  • Experience with data analysis and business intelligence (BI), including building dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, and turning data into clear, actionable insights  
  • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, overfitting, and model evaluation metrics  
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply coursework to real-world scenarios 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical results to non-technical audiences 
Nice to Have Skills
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases  
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and frameworks such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, LangChain, or LlamaIndex  
  • Experience with at least one deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow  
  • Experience fine-tuning or adapting pre-trained models (for example, Hugging Face Transformers or LoRA)  
  • Experience evaluating ML or LLM systems, such as building test sets and measuring accuracy, drift, or hallucination rates  
  • Exposure to big data and orchestration tools such as Spark, Airflow, or Databricks, and to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI)  
  • Basic model deployment and MLOps skills, such as building REST APIs (FastAPI or Flask), Docker, or experiment tracking with MLflow  
  • Exposure to knowledge representation techniques such as knowledge graphs
